description:
'''Andersen'''

Scandinavian

This last name was originally a typical '''Scandinavian [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patronymic Patronymic]''':  For Scandinavian families. It was only introduced as a last name or family name around 1850-1900.

* Søn af Anders = Andersen (Danish)
* Son of Anders = Andersen

[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hans_Christian_Andersen Hans Christian Andersen] was a famous Danish writer, he wrote a lot of fairy-tales, e.g. "''The Little Mermaid''".
